# Two Knights — Quest Script

**This is a fill-in document.** Generated by `Tools/gen_quest_script.py` from the quest
line files under `Assets/Scripts/Quests/Lines/`. Every field is prefilled with its
current value except the three you are writing:

- **OFFER** — what the NPC says when the quest first appears. Currently blank.
- **IN PROGRESS** — the quest log body. Prefilled with the existing text; edit freely.
- **COMPLETED** — what the NPC says when you finish it. Currently blank.
- **Tutorial run** — `yes` or `no`. See below.

Nothing is implemented from this document until you hand it back.

## The tutorial-run rule

During the player's tutorial run, a quest marked **`no`** makes **no progress at all** —
its stats still accumulate, but the quest neither advances nor unlocks nor completes.
A quest marked **`yes`** behaves normally.

Default below is `no` for everything. Flip the starting quests you want live during
that first run to `yes` — you mentioned the Rat King quest and the line running on to
the Crimson Twins.

## House style, for reference

- Descriptions are **paragraphs**, 3-5 sentences, plain and grounded. Terse portentous
  one-liners were tried and rejected.
- **Quest prose carries no numbers.** Numbers live in the objective line.
- **Never print world units** — no `2.3u`. Percentages if a size must be described.
- Recurring threads: the quartermaster and his tally board, the scouts whose maps
  disagree, the Orders finding you rather than the reverse.

> **Two targets are computed at runtime, not authored.** The explorer finales
> (`forest_explorer_2` = 45, `mine_explorer_2` = 42) count every playable wave on
> their map, so both numbers move whenever waves are added. They are shown here as
> they stood when this was generated.

# Combination upgrades — new quests

These two do not exist yet. They are the only cross-order combination upgrades in the
game today, found by walking the actual unlock graph in `Assets/Upgrades/`:
**Sleeping Dart** (`secondOrder`) and **Fire Sight** (Ember order count + a Guardian
prerequisite). *Guided Reflections* is excluded — both its parents are Guardian, so it
is a chain-meets-chain combo inside one Order rather than a two-Order one.

Each combination upgrade **stays out of the draft entirely** until its quest unlocks.
The quest opens the moment one knight first qualifies on both Orders; the player then
sees the upgrade appear, takes it, and the quest completes.
